items.title: Norwegian AI debt-collection startup Audun raises $3M from Y Combinator and Alliance VC
items.summary: Audun is an Oslo-based, licensed debt collection agency founded in June 2026. It uses AI agents to handle routine collection tasks such as communicating with debtors and answering simple questions. Cases that need human judgment go to human case handlers. The $3M round came from Alliance VC and Y Combinator, with Robinhood Ventures, Skyfall, First Degree and angel investors also taking part. The company serves several dozen clients in Norway and is expanding into Sweden.
items.why_it_matters: It is a concrete example of an AI-native Norwegian startup taking on a regulated financial service, backed by Y Combinator.
